description: Source code for the wld_vendorModule component, implementing vendor module registration, unregistration, API forwarding, and trace zone management.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_nameSpace
methods.description: Returns the namespace string for vendor modules.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_apiId
methods.description: Retrieves the API ID corresponding to a given API name.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_apiName
methods.description: Retrieves the API name corresponding to a given API ID.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_unregister
methods.description: Unregisters a vendor module by name.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_register
methods.description: Registers a new vendor module with specified configuration.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_forwardCall
methods.description: Forwards a function call to the appropriate vendor module handler.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_loadOdls
methods.description: Loads ODLs (Object Description Language files) from a specified path.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_parseOdl
methods.description: Parses an ODL file from a specified path.

methods.name: wld_vendorModule_loadPrivTraceZones
methods.description: Loads private trace zone configurations and applies them.
